description: Chunk document text in a Web Worker, compute local cosine-similarity embeddings (bge-micro ~22 MB + pdfjs-dist), and answer questions or summarize key points with 0 server uploads.

seo.metaTitle: Chat with PDF & document Q&A — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Chunk document text in a Web Worker, compute local cosine-similarity embeddings (bge-micro ~22 MB + pdfjs-dist), and answer questions or summarize key points with 0 server uploads. Runs 100% locally in your browser via bge-micro-v2-q8 with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Chat with PDF & document Q&A processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using bge-micro-v2-q8 (Tier M). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Chat with PDF & document Q&A upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Chat with PDF & document Q&A executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using bge-micro-v2-q8. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Chat with PDF & document Q&A?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/chat_pdf.json or open /tools/chat-pdf?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
